title: Heart With Arrow Emoji 💘 Meaning: Struck by Cupid
description: The 💘 heart with arrow emoji means falling in love or having a crush, as if hit by Cupid's arrow. See how it is used in texts and on Valentine's Day.
summary: The 💘 heart with arrow emoji shows a heart pierced by an arrow, a reference to Cupid. It means being lovestruck: falling for someone, having a crush, or feeling smitten. It is common on Valentine's Day and in messages about new romance, matchmaking, and love at first sight.
meaning: In Roman myth, Cupid's arrows made their targets fall in love on the spot, and the pierced heart has been the symbol of that sudden feeling ever since. 💘 keeps the idea intact. It is the heart for the start of things: a crush, a first date that went well, the moment you realize you like someone. Where ❤️ states love as a settled fact, this one describes love as something that happened to you.

That makes it useful for talking about attraction with a little humor. 'He remembered my coffee order 💘' admits to being won over. People use it about celebrities and fictional characters as freely as about real prospects, and friends use it when playing matchmaker or teasing someone about an obvious crush. Dating apps and matchmaking content lean on it for the same reason.

Valentine's Day is its busiest season, when it decorates cards, promotions, and party invitations as shorthand for Cupid. The arrow occasionally leads people to read it as heartache, a wounded heart, but that is not the usual meaning; pain belongs to 💔. In practice 💘 is upbeat, flirtatious, and a touch dramatic.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: This is a fairly direct signal. Sending 💘 after a date or a compliment says 'you got me.' It is more specific than a red heart because it names the feeling as romantic attraction. If someone you are getting to know uses it about you, they are saying they are smitten.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Friends report crushes with it and tease each other about theirs. Couples use it in early, giddy stages, or later to say a partner still makes them swoon. It also works for non-romantic infatuations, such as a new city, a song, or a puppy that has stolen your heart.

contexts.label: On holidays
contexts.body: On Valentine's Day 💘 stands for Cupid himself, appearing in greetings, classroom valentines, and event names. Brands use it in gift guides and date-night promotions. Singles use it wryly in posts about dodging Cupid or waiting for his aim to improve.

examples.text: She laughed at my worst joke. I'm done for 💘
examples.meaning: The sender has fallen hard for someone.

examples.text: Happy Valentine's Day to my favorite person 💘
You two would be perfect together 💘

combos.meaning: Cupid's arrow has landed, or someone is setting two people up.
Instantly smitten at the sight of someone.
A date night or engagement celebration.
Cupid, used for Valentine's Day or matchmaking.

confusedWith.difference: 💔 is a heart cracked in two and means heartbreak or disappointment. 💘 is whole, with an arrow through it, and means falling in love. The arrow is Cupid's, not a wound.

❤️ is the all-purpose declaration of love for partners, family, and friends. 💘 is narrower: it is about being struck by romantic feeling, so it suits crushes and new relationships more than long-standing bonds.
💗 shows a heart expanding and suggests affection that is building steadily. 💘 is the sudden version, love as a bolt from nowhere.

avoid: Do not send it to friends or coworkers who might take it as a romantic advance, since it is one of the more explicitly amorous hearts.
Avoid using it to express heartache, because most readers will see infatuation instead.
design: The emoji is a pink or red heart with an arrow passing diagonally through it, the point emerging on one side and the fletching on the other. The heart's shade varies by vendor, from bright pink to deep red, and arrow colors differ as well. The arrow's direction is not consistent across platforms.

faqs.q: What does 💘 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: He is saying he is taken with you, or with whatever he is talking about. Directed at you, it is a clear sign of romantic interest. Men tend to use it less than plain hearts, so it often carries extra intent.

faqs.q: What does 💘 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: It usually means she has a crush or feels swept off her feet. Check the target: about you, it is flirtation; about a singer or a pair of boots, it is just enthusiasm.
No. Although an arrow through a heart could look painful, the image refers to Cupid's arrow causing love. For heartbreak, people use 💔.
It is most visible in February, but it works any time someone is falling for someone. It has been part of the standard emoji set since 2010.
